instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' fonts from Google Fonts via next/font or standard import.
Do NOT use generic Inter/Roboto for any text.
Do NOT use any gradients or purple/teal colors. Stick strictly to the provided earthy/organic color palette.
Ensure generous spacing in the storefront. Product cards should have large images with minimal text below them.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons with thin weights to match the luxury aesthetic.
For the Custom Design page, provide a clean, minimal file upload area and text areas for notes/measurements. Use the 'about_craftsmanship' image to enhance the storytelling on this page.
For the admin dashboard, use a tighter grid, pure white backgrounds, and clear visual hierarchy for data tables.
Currency is INR (₹). Ensure all prices are formatted correctly.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
